cluster_stories.title: South Korea's SK Hynix, Samsung Electronics sign $950 billion partnership with US big tech
cluster_stories.summary: The partnership includes the long-term supply of $750 ​billion in memory ​chips to US companies by SK Hynix ‌and $200 billion in chips ​by Samsung ​Electronics ⁠to Broadcom, the presidential adviser, Kim Yong-beom, ​said at a briefing.

cluster_stories.title: Samsung signs a $200 billion chip deal with Broadcom covering memory, foundry and advanced packaging through 2030

The deal, announced on Friday at an AI summit in San Francisco, runs for five years through 2030 and covers some of the most critical layers of the […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: SAMSUNG SIGNS $200B CHIP DEAL With Broadcom... AI Foundry Push

cluster_stories.title: Samsung Electronics wins $200 billion Broadcom AI chip partnership, boosting foundry push
cluster_stories.summary: The tie-up comes as global technology companies increasingly develop their own custom ​AI accelerators, rather than relying solely on ⁠general-purpose graphics processors, ‌driving demand for specialised chip design and manufacturing ​partnerships. The next five years of collaboration will combine Broadcom's expertise in designing application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), or chips for specific tasks, with Samsung's manufacturing capabilities.
cluster_stories.headline: Samsung Wins $200B Broadcom AI Chip Partnership Through 2030

cluster_stories.title: SK Chair Says Anthropic Asked for Supplies to Make Its Own Chips

cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC ASKS SK HYNIX FOR CHIP-MAKING SUPPLIES
